title: Friends of Tunbridge Wells and Rusthall Commons

announcement.text: Over 3,000 residents have backed The Friends' community bid to buy the Commons.

hero.kicker: Protecting 256 Acres of Historic Common Land
hero.headline: Ancient Woodland, Trails & Sandstone Rocks at the Heart of Our Community
hero.lead: Tunbridge Wells and Rusthall Commons are free and open for everyone to explore 365 days a year. The Friends are a registered charity dedicated to keeping this treasured landscape safe, protected, and in community hands forever.

visiting.location: Tunbridge Wells Common and Rusthall Common, Royal Tunbridge Wells, Kent. Tunbridge Wells station is a 7-minute walk from the edge of the commons.
visiting.parking: Free visitor parking bays on Fir Tree Road (TN4 8AH). Please take litter home.
